_comment: Point-in-time factors on top of the team model (scripts/mk2/eval_factors.py, walk-forward 2025-08..2026-10, ~16k team rows per statistic). b = change of log expected count per one standard deviation of the factor; mean/sd standardize the factor. Factors are residuals log((y+0.5)/(mu+0.5)) against the model: form5 = team's last 5 matches, venue5 = team's last 5 at the same venue, oppc5 = what the opponent conceded in its last 5, ref = referee's shrunk mean residual (sum/(n+20)). Corners: no out-of-sample gain, so no factor. Line-ups and congestion: too small to use.
